mustFix.problem: The hero depicts pool-cage re-screening, a service not in facts.json, so the first screen advertises work the business doesn't do (implied invented claim); the 390 crop shows no water at all
mustFix.fix: Replace it with an approved residential pool frame where the water is the subject (screened lanai pool in low morning light, or a brush/pole at the waterline); keep the left third dark for the h1 scrim and set object-position so the water stays in the 390 crop

elevate.move: Make every frame an attachment a real tech on a Tampa route would have taken: all residential, all from the deck at the same early hour, one cool grade, water as the subject, so the photos are the evidence that 'written down' promises rather than decoration beside it

Let the hero be the visit itself: water at 07:58 with the first log line burned into the photo as a large stamped caption, and the 08:45 finished-report notification as the payoff object waiting at the fold, so the first screen shows the start and end of the visit and the spine picks up from there
